    <h1 class="devsite-page-title" tabindex="-1">
      Webhooks<devsite-actions hidden data-nosnippet>
    <devsite-llm-tools></devsite-llm-tools></devsite-actions>
  
      
    </h1>
  <div class="devsite-page-title-meta"><devsite-view-release-notes></devsite-view-release-notes></div>
  

  <devsite-toc class="devsite-nav"
    depth="2"
    devsite-toc-embedded
    >
  </devsite-toc>
  
    
  <div class="devsite-article-body clearfix
  ">

  
    
    
<div id="gemini-api-switcher-trigger" style="display:none;"></div>

<p>
</p>



<p>Webhooks allow the Gemini API to push real-time notifications to your server
when asynchronous or Long-Running Operations (LROs) complete. This replaces the
need to poll the API for status updates, reducing latency and overhead.</p>

<p>Webhooks are available for operations like <a href="/gemini-api/docs/batch-api">Batch</a> jobs,
<a href="/gemini-api/docs/interactions-overview">Interactions</a> and <a href="/gemini-api/docs/video">video generation</a>.</p>

<h2 id="how-it-works" data-text="How it works" tabindex="-1">How it works</h2>

<p>Instead of polling <code translate="no" dir="ltr">GET /operations</code> repeatedly to check if a job is finished,
you can configure Gemini API Webhooks to send an HTTP POST request to your
listener URL immediately upon an event trigger.</p>

<p>The Gemini API supports two ways to configure webhooks:</p>

<ul>
<li><a href="#static-webhooks"><strong>Static webhooks</strong></a>: Project-level endpoints configured
with the Gemini <a href="/api">WebhookService API</a>. Good for global integrations (e.g., notifying Slack, syncing a
database, etc.).</li>
<li><a href="#dynamic-webhooks"><strong>Dynamic webhooks</strong></a>: Request-level overrides passing a
webhook URL in the configuration payload of a specific jobs call. Ideal for
routing specific jobs to dedicated endpoints.</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="static-webhooks" data-text="Static webhooks" tabindex="-1">Static webhooks</h2>

<p>Static webhooks are registered for a whole <a href="/gemini-api/docs/api-key#google-cloud-projects">project</a> and trigger for any matching
event.</p>

<h3 id="create-webhook" data-text="Create a webhook" tabindex="-1">Create a webhook</h3>

<p>You can create endpoints using the SDK or REST API.</p>

<p><strong>IMPORTANT</strong>: When creating a webhook, the API returns a <strong>signing secret</strong>
<strong>only once</strong>. You must store this securely (e.g. in your environment variables)
to verify signatures later. If you lose the signing secret, you&#39;ll have to
<a href="#rotate-signing-secret">rotate</a> it.</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">google</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">genai</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">Client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">webhook</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">webhooks</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">create</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">name</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"MyBatchWebhook"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">subscribed_events</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"batch.succeeded"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"batch.failed"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">],</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">uri</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"https://my-api.com/gemini-callback"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Store webhook.new_signing_secret securely</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-n">webhook_secret</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">webhook</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">new_signing_secret</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-sa">f</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Created webhook: </span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">webhook</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">name</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">, </span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">webhook</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">id</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-k">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GoogleGenAI</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kr">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"@google/genai"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-kd">const</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">client</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-ow">new</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">GoogleGenAI</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">();</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-k">async</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kd">function</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nx">createWebhook</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">()</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>

<h3 id="handle-webhook-requests" data-text="Handle webhook requests on a server" tabindex="-1">Handle webhook requests on a server</h3>

<p>When an event happens that you&#39;re subscribed to, your webhook URL will receive
an HTTP POST request. Your endpoint must respond with a 2xx status
code within a few seconds to avoid a retry. To ensure delivery, the Gemini API
automatically retries failed requests for 24 hours using exponential backoff.</p>

<p>Gemini strictly follows the <a href="https://github.com/standard-webhooks/standard-webhooks">Standard Webhooks</a> specification for
security headers. Verify the payload on your server using the signed header
signatures and your stored static signing secret. See the <a href="#webhook-envelope">Webhook envelope</a> section for the payload information.</p>

<p>Here is an example using Flask for the HTTP listener:</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">
<section><h3 id="python_6" data-text="Python" tabindex="-1">Python</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="Python"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># pip install flask standardwebhooks</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">os</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">flask</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">Flask</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">request</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">jsonify</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Standard verification wrapper for Standard Webhook Headers</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-kn">from</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nn">standardwebhooks.webhooks</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-kn">import</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">Webhook</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">WebhookVerificationError</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">app</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">Flask</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-vm">__name__</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">SIGNING_SECRET</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">os</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">environ</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">get</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-nd">@app</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">route</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'/gemini-callback'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">methods</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'POST'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">])</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-k">def</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nf">gemini_callback</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">():</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">payload</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">request</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">get_data</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">as_text</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-kc">True</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">headers</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">request</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">headers</span>

    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">try</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-n">wh</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">Webhook</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">SIGNING_SECRET</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-n">event</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">wh</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">verify</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">payload</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">headers</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">except</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">WebhookVerificationError</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-k">as</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">e</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-k">return</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">jsonify</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">({</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"error"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Signature invalid"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}),</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-mi">400</span>

    <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Process thin payload contents</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">event</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">get</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">==</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"batch.succeeded"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-sa">f</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Batch completed! ID: </span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">event</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'data'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">][</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'id'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">event</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"data"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">get</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"output_file_uri"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">):</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># For batch jobs with input file</span>
            <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-sa">f</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Batch file: </span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">event</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'data'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">][</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'output_file_uri'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">elif</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">event</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">get</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">==</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"interaction.completed"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-sa">f</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Interaction completed! ID: </span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">event</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'data'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">][</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'id'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">elif</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">event</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">get</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">==</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"video.generated"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
        <span class="devsite-syntax-nb">print</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-sa">f</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Video generated! URI: </span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">{</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">event</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'data'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">][</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s1">'output_file_uri'</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">]</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>

    <span class="devsite-syntax-k">return</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-n">jsonify</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">({</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"status"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"received"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}),</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-mi">200</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-k">if</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-vm">__name__</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">==</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"__main__"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span>
    <span class="devsite-syntax-n">app</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">.</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">run</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-n">port</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-mi">8000</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">)</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code></section>
<section><h3 id="javascript_6" data-text="JavaScript" tabindex="-1">JavaScript</h3><div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JavaScript"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-c1">// npm install standardwebhooks</span>

<h2 id="dynamic-webhooks" data-text="Dynamic webhooks" tabindex="-1">Dynamic webhooks</h2>

<p>Dynamic webhooks allow you to bind a webhook endpoint to a <strong>specific request
configuration</strong>, ideal for agent-orchestration queues. Dynamic webhooks leverage
asymmetric public-key JWKS signatures instead of symmetric secrets.</p>

<h3 id="submit-dynamic-request" data-text="Submit a dynamic request" tabindex="-1">Submit a dynamic request</h3>

<p>Add a <code translate="no" dir="ltr">webhook_config</code> when triggering an asynchronous job (e.g., creating a
Batch).</p>
<div><devsite-selector data-ds-scope="code-sample">

<h3 id="verify-dynamic-signatures" data-text="Verify dynamic signatures (JWKS)" tabindex="-1">Verify dynamic signatures (JWKS)</h3>

must extract the signature and verify it using <a href="https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/certs">Google&#39;s public certificate
endpoints</a>.</p>

<h2 id="webhook-envelope" data-text="Webhook envelope" tabindex="-1">Webhook envelope</h2>

<p>To avoid bandwidth congestion, Gemini webhooks use a <strong>thin payload</strong> model to
deliver data.
deliveries send a snapshot containing status details and pointers to results,
rather than the raw output file itself.</p>

<p>Here is an example payload format:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JSON"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"batch.succeeded"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"version"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"v1"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"timestamp"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"2026-01-22T12:00:00Z"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"data"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"id"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"batch_123456"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"output_file_uri"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"gs://my-bucket/results.jsonl"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<h2 id="event-catalog" data-text="Event catalog reference" tabindex="-1">Event catalog reference</h2>

<p>The following events are triggered for supporting jobs:</p>

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">Event type</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Trigger</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Payload item (<code translate="no" dir="ltr">data</code>)</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">batch.succeeded</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Processing finished successfully.</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">id</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">output_file_uri</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">batch.cancelled</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">User cancelled request</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">id</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">batch.expired</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Batch has not been processed (finished) in 24h timeframe</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">id</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">batch.failed</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Batch job failed (system or validation error).</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">id</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">error_code</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">error_message</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">interaction.requires_action</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Function call, user needs to do something</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">id</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">interaction.completed</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">LRO in interactions API succeeded</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">id</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">interaction.failed</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">LRO in interactions API failed (system or validation error).</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">id</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">error_code</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">error_message</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">interaction.cancelled</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">LRO in interactions API cancelled</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">id</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">video.generated</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Video generation LRO completed.</td>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">id</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">output_file_uri</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">file_name</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h2 id="best-practices" data-text="Best practices" tabindex="-1">Best practices</h2>

<p>To ensure reliable, scalable operation:</p>

<ul>
<li><strong>Strict replay protection check</strong>: All requests carry a <code translate="no" dir="ltr">webhook-timestamp</code>
header. Always validate this timestamp on your server configuration layer to
reject payloads older than <strong>5 minutes</strong> (to mitigate replay attacks).</li>
<li><strong>Process asynchronously</strong>: Respond with <code translate="no" dir="ltr">2xx OK</code> immediately upon valid
signature detection, and queue parsing operations internally. Prolonged listener
hold times will trigger a delivery retry cycle.</li>
<li><strong>Deduplication handling</strong>: Standard webhooks deliver &quot;At-least-once&quot;. Use the
consistent <code translate="no" dir="ltr">webhook-id</code> header to handle potential duplicates in higher
congestion flows.</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="whats-next" data-text="What's next?" tabindex="-1">What's next?</h2>

<ul>
<li><a href="/gemini-api/docs/batch-api">Batch API</a>: Utilize webhooks to automate high volume endpoints.</li>
</ul>
